blocks.title: Retardation factor Rf
blocks.text: Har juz ka khaas retardation factor hota hai: Rf = (asal spot se juz ka chala faasla) / (asal spot se solvent ka chala faasla).

Figure 15.10 ke chromatogram mein namoona A mein B aur C dono ajza hain, jin ki Rf qeematein Rf(B) = x/y aur Rf(C) = x'/y hain. Paper chromatography reaction mein bane madde ke khalis ya na-khalis hone ki jaanch ka aasan tareeqa hai, aise munasib solvent se jis mein woh hale: khalis madda ek spot deta hai, na-khalis ek se zyada. Chromatogram maloom khalis namoonon se muqabla kar ke madde pehchanta bhi hai; do madde ek jaise hone ka imkan rakhte hain agar un ka Rf ek ho. Figure 15.10 mein na-khalis madda do rangeen spots dikhata hai, jo reference khalis compounds jitne faasle chale hain. Ek hi stationary aur mobile phases ke saath kisi madde ki Rf qeemat hamesha ek jaisi hoti hai.

blocks.caption: Chromatogram parhna
rows: maloom khalis namoone jaise Rf par spot

blocks.prompt: Rf qeemat aur us ka istemal bayan karein, aur wazeh karein ke agar do ajza ki stationary phase se kashish milti julti ho to kya hota hai (exercise Q.2g, l).
blocks.explanation: Rf juz ke chale faasle ko solvent front ke chale faasle par taqseem kar ke milta hai, dono asal se; yeh diye gaye phases mein kisi madde ke liye mustaqil hai, to muqable se madde pehchanta aur purity dikhata hai, khalis madde ke liye ek spot. Agar do ajza stationary phase se taqreeban barabar pakre hon to woh taqreeban ek raftar se chalte hain aur un ke spots ek doosre par aa jate hain, to unhen alag karne ko solvent badalna parta hai.

items: Rf = juz ka faasla / solvent front ka faasla; ek hi phases mein madde ke liye mustaqil; ek spot = khalis, zyada = na-khalis; maloom namoone se Rf milana madda pehchanta hai.
